Build a production-grade pricing plan dialog with feature comparison table for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`. Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read: - `src/components/SubscriptionDialog.tsx` — current subscription dialog (will be replaced) - `src/pages/Billing.tsx` — billing page where the dialog is triggered - `src/components/settings/AccountInfoCard.tsx` — where "Manage Plan" button lives - `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` — find the pricing section for the plan data ## What to build Replace `src/components/SubscriptionDialog.tsx` with a premium pricing dialog that has: ### 1. Dialog structure ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Choose your plan [X] │ │ Unlock more features as you grow. │ │ │ │ [Monthly] [Annual — Save 20%] │ │ │ │ ┌──────┐ ┌──────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────┐ │ │ │ Free │ │Start.│ │ Growth │ │Agency│ │ │ │ $0 │ │ $29 │ │ $79 │ │ $149 │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │POPULAR │ │ │ │ │ │[Curr]│ │[Upgr]│ │[Upgrade]│ │[Talk]│ │ │ └──────┘ └──────┘ └─────────┘ └──────┘ │ │ │ │ ─── Feature Comparison ─── │ │ │ │ CORE FEATURES Free Start Growth Agency │ │ AI Resume Ranking ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ Active Jobs 1 5 20 ∞ │ │ CVs per month 50 500 2,000 10,000 │ │ Team Members 1 ∞ ∞ ∞ │ │ ... │ │ │ │ AI FEATURES Free Start Growth Agency │ │ AI JD Generator ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ AI Candidate Summary ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ AI Resume Authenticity — ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ AI Search — — ✓ ✓ │ │ ... │ │ │ │ COLLABORATION Free Start Growth Agency │ │ Candidate Notes ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ @Mentions — ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ Scorecards — ✓ ✓ ✓ │ │ ... │ │ │ │ AGENCY FEATURES Free Start Growth Agency │ │ White-label — — — ✓ │ │ Client Portal — — ✓ ✓ │ │ ... │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 2. Plan cards (top section) 4 plans in a horizontal row. Each card: - Plan name - Price (`$0`, `$29`, `$79`, `$149`) with `/month` suffix - Annual price shown when toggled (`$23`, `$63`, `$119`) - Key limit: "X active jobs · Y CVs/month" - CTA button: "Current Plan" (disabled, outline) for current plan, "Upgrade" (primary) for higher plans, "Contact Sales" for Agency - Growth card: highlighted with `border-2 border-primary`, "Most Popular" badge ### 3. Implementation Use `Dialog` (not Sheet) — centered modal, max-w-5xl, with ScrollArea for the comparison table. ```tsx {/* Header */}
Choose your plan Unlock more features as you grow. All plans include unlimited users. {/* Billing toggle */}
Monthly Annual Save 20%
{/* Plan cards row */}
{plans.map(plan => )}
{/* Comparison table */}
{categories.map(cat => )}
``` ### 5. Comparison table cell rendering For each feature cell: - `✓` (checkmark) → `` - `—` (not included) → `—` - Number (like "5", "500") → `{value}` - "Unlimited" → `∞` ### 6. Props — keep same interface ```typescript interface SubscriptionDialogProps { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; } ``` The dialog internally fetches plans from the `plans` table and the user's current plan from `useAuth()`. ### 7. CTA behavior - "Current Plan" → disabled button - "Upgrade" → calls `create-dodo-checkout` edge function (keep existing checkout flow) - "Contact Sales" → opens email or book-demo link - "Downgrade" shown only if on a higher plan ## Constraints - NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` - `(supabase as any)` for queries - `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts - Keep existing Dodo Payments checkout integration - Run `npm run build` — zero errors
